title: Root cause analysis via difference graph discovery from linear time-series data
abstract: arXiv:2608.21117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Root cause analysis aims to identify the mechanisms responsible for anomalies in complex dynamical systems. In this paper, we study root cause analysis in linear time-series through the lens of difference graph discovery. We focus on effect-defying root causes, corresponding to variables whose causal coefficients change between a normal and an anomalous regime. We formalize this problem using linear discrete-time dynamic structural causal models and adapt several methods originally introduced for discovering difference graphs between two populations to the time-series setting, where the two populations are replaced by a normal and an anomalous regime. We first evaluate the proposed approaches on simulated data, and then demonstrate their practical relevance on real-world datasets from IT monitoring and intensive care monitoring. Our results show how difference graph discovery can help localize causal mechanisms responsible for anomalous

translated_title: 基于线性时间序列数据差异图发现的根因分析
translated_abstract: 根因分析旨在识别复杂动态系统中导致异常的机制。在本文中，我们通过差异图发现的视角研究线性时间序列中的根因分析。我们重点关注违反效应的根因，即对应于在正常和异常状态之间因果系数发生变化的变量。我们使用线性离散时间动态结构因果模型形式化该问题，并调整了几种最初用于发现两个群体之间差异图的方法，以适应时间序列设置，其中两个群体被替换为正常和异常状态。我们首先在模拟数据上评估所提出的方法，然后展示其在来自IT监控和重症监护监控的真实世界数据集上的实际相关性。我们的结果表明，差异图发现如何帮助定位导致异常的因果机制。
tldr: 本文提出通过差异图发现方法，在线性时间序列中识别异常状态下因果系数变化的变量，从而定位根因，并在模拟和真实数据上验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using difference graph discovery to identify variables with altered causal coefficients in anomalous regimes within linear time-series, effectively localizing root causes, validated on simulated and real-world data.
